events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $5.95 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
The trip ran 17.6 km against an optimal 13.3 km, a deviation of 4.3 km (billed-vs-optimal 4.22 km) [F1][F4][RD-1], well over the 1 km tolerance, so RD-1 is passed and the excess distance fare is in play [RD-2]. One off-route segment is measured: 09:06–09:16, 6.29 km driven where the optimal route covers 2.26 km, adding 4.03 km [F3].

Consent. The driver asked at 09:03: "can I go round via Ubi Avenue 2?" [F7] and the rider answered "Sure, no problem." [F8] — a specific named road agreed before the segment began (segment start 09:06, the chat is timestamped 09:03 and the chat record is complete and timestamped) [F9][RD-5]. But "Ubi Avenue 2" is not among the roads driven on F3 (KAKI BUKIT ROAD 2 → … → JALAN EUNOS → … → PIPIT ROAD), and the driver himself states he went by Jalan Eunos instead "because it looked clearer" [F10]. The rider's agreement therefore covers a route the car did not take: the scope is named_road_elsewhere and counts under RD-5.

RD-3 does not exempt the segment: no rider message named the roads actually driven, no destination change or added stop was accepted, and no stop was measured on this segment [F7][F8][RD-3]. The traffic reason on the replaced stretch (Kallang Paya Lebar Expressway, speed band 2) is on record [F11][F14] but under RD-2/RD-4 a traffic reason never exempts a segment: the amount turns only on rider agreement to the route, which is absent here [RD-2][RD-5].

Amount: deviation 4.22 km [F4] less exempt km (0) = 4.22 km; (4.22 km − 0 km exempt) × $1.4103/km = $5.95 [F4][RD-2]. Tolls, time fare and surge are not refunded; the multiplier is 1.0× so no surge component [F5][F6][RD-2]. Since what is left (4.22 km) exceeds 1 km, the outcome is refund_partial of $5.95, matching the trace and the DISP-001 precedent of a per-km excess-distance refund [PREC-1][RD-1][RD-2].

RD-6 is checked: the driver has 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days [F17][RD-6], so no account flag; the profile does not decide the case. Safety screen: I read the rider's complaint, the driver's chat [F7], the rider's reply [F8] and the driver's statement [F10] — a route/pricing argument only, no threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation, so no escalation under SAFE-1.
